source_native_definition.carrier: Source uses three Hermitian 2x2 Pauli matrices sigma_I and their anti-Hermitian real su(2) generators T_I=(i/2)sigma_I, I=1..3.
source_native_definition.source_claim_scope: Original §2.2 internal SU(2) Lie bracket basis with real structure constants, not the later arbitrary gravitational spinor commutator.
source_native_definition.adjacent_carrier_scope: The electroweak SU(2)_L generator acts only on left-chiral fermion doublets through P_L; that later chiral restriction must not be substituted for the original unprojected three-generator su2 basis bracket.
source_native_definition.connection_to_original_Eq2_1: Follows author Pauli multiplication identity sigma_I sigma_J = delta_IJ 1 + i epsilon_IJ^K sigma_K; this author explicit commutator is not omitted merely because inferable from Eq2.1.
